messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's PM (burst eviction during capacity padding). Need firm owners, JIRA links, and a short RACI for the 4 follow-ups. I'll seed suggestions 1: owners, ETAs, and a ticket-aging rule.

Jordan: Ack. Can we separate immediate mitigations (safety knobs) vs infra changes (cache sizing)? I can take infra.

Samir: I'll take the immediate mitigations (auto-throttle + emergency pad) and the canary plan. ETA: 72h. R=Samir, A=Maya, C=Jordan, I=Lina (QA).

Lina (QA): I'll own the regression harness and CI gate. ETA for initial PR: 8 days. Will add deterministic repros that simulate repeated micro-bursts.

Maya: I created PM-3124 and linked issues: ACT-5001 (auto-throttle + rollback), ACT-5002 (cache-sizing + metrics), ACT-5003 (regression harness + gating), ACT-5004 (postmortem cadence note + playbook).

Ops Bot: Created Jira issues ACT-5001, ACT-5002, ACT-5003, ACT-5004 and linked to PM-3124.

Jordan: ACT-5002 assigned to Jordan. ETA: 2 weeks. I'll open a brief design doc and a small spike to test new cache limits under load. Will post perf baselines in the ticket.

Samir: ACT-5001 assigned to Samir. I'll push a config patch and a 1-hour canary window. Acceptance: canary shows eviction < 0.1% for 30m without service regressing.

Lina (QA): ACT-5003 assigned to Lina (QA). I'll add repro scripts and a CI gate: staging must pass deterministic repro for 24h before merge. Acceptance: CI reproduces issue reliably and gating blocks bad merges.

Maya: Hand-off plan for the 3-week remediation window: week1 primary = Samir (mitigations), week2 primary = Jordan (infra + sizing), week3 primary = Maya (validation + closeout). Please update your Jira tickets with owner, ETA, and a 1-2 line acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. If blocked, mark the ticket and ping me.

Jordan: Also proposing we add a "stale-owner SLA" so action items get a forced review at day 4. Draft automation below.

```
Jira Automation:
when: issue created or updated
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: add comment "Owner review required: update ETA or flag blocker"; set label "needs-owner-review"; transition to "Needs Review"; ping #postmortems
```

Lina (QA): +1. Also suggest tagging PM-3124 with label "recurring-pattern" 1 this looks like the 2nd similar eviction in 6 weeks. Will add notes in ACT-5004.

Samir: I'll attach the canary plan and current eviction metrics to ACT-5001. Ping me if you need dashboard access.

Maya: Closing loop 1 reminder: update assigned tickets (owner + ETA + acceptance) by EOD tomorrow. If anyone expects delays, update the ticket and I'll reassign. If tickets sit idle after 4 days the automation will force a review. :white_check_mark:
